g.title: HDV_QSP
g.text: Chronic Hepatitis D (HDV) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
two-substrate assembly line: host-made genome × HBV-made envelope · 18 clusters · 168 nodes
therapies placed on the flux they cut — entry (bulevirtide) · envelopment (lonafarnib, siRNA/NAP) · intracellular + infected-cell loss (IFN-α/λ)

g.title: cluster_entry
g.text: ② 세포 진입 (Entry: HSPG → NTCP/SLC10A1 → endocytosis)

g.title: cluster_repl
g.text: ③ 세포내 복제 (Host Pol II rolling-circle replication)

g.title: cluster_hbv
g.text: ⑤ HBV — 외피 공급원 (cccDNA → HBsAg envelope supply)

g.title: cluster_spread
g.text: ⑦ NTCP-비의존 유지 경로 — 진입억제제의 바닥 (The floor an entry inhibitor cannot cross)

g.title: cluster_innate
g.text: ⑧ 선천면역 (MDA5 → IFN-β/λ → JAK-STAT → ISG · SOCS1 feedback)

g.title: cluster_fib
g.text: ⑪ 섬유화 (HSC activation → collagen → portal hypertension)

g.title: cluster_clin
g.text: ⑫ 임상 결과 (Cirrhosis → decompensation → HCC → death)

g.title: cluster_ba
g.text: ⑭ 담즙산 — 표적점유율의 생체표지자 (Bile acids as an NTCP-occupancy read-out)

g.title: cluster_ifn
g.text: ⑮ 인터페론 (PegIFN alfa-2a · PegIFN lambda — PK/PD and toxicity)

g.title: cluster_lnf
g.text: ⑯ 로나파닙/리토나비르 (Lonafarnib + ritonavir boost — assembly inhibitor)

g.title: cluster_hbsagtx
g.text: ⑰ HBsAg 표적·배경 치료 (NUC · siRNA/ASO · NAP · vaccine)

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: ⑱ 임상 평가지표 (Endpoints and the decoupling between them)

g.title: decouple
g.text: the INFLOW of newly infected cells,
